Why your privacy matters in todays tech world

Do you own a VR headset or smartwatch? A lot of people do in todays tech world, but have you ever stopped to think about the data that these devices are tracking? VR/AR headsets and smart watch collect physcial, environmental, and biometric data without the user ever knowing.
